name: apple-eventkit
description: Local, security-focused Apple Calendar and Reminders reading and approved creation through EventKit.

interface.shortDescription: Use Apple Calendar and Reminders locally.
interface.longDescription: Read Calendar and Reminders data and create explicitly confirmed events or reminders in a selected writable calendar or list. EventKit access remains on this Mac.
defaultPrompt: Show my calendars and their stable IDs.
Create an event after I approve its exact details.
Create a reminder in a specific list after I approve its exact details.
